fatal_failures: the exact public static ValidateReportSequence(List<Report>) entry point or required public support types are absent
CORRECT is accepted after ERROR without an intervening REVIVE
a rejected report changes lifecycle state, replaces the anchored UTI, or prevents later reports from being evaluated
TERMINATED and CANCELLED are collapsed so the existed-versus-never-valid distinction is lost
the implementation replaces the typed CDM 7.0.0 TradeIdentifier boundary with an invented UTI model or edits generated model code

criteria.description: Expose the exact typed batch-validation contract and one decision per report.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.reporting.UtiReportSequenceValidator.ValidateReportSequence directly.
Expose the required action, state, rejection-reason, report, decision, and result types.
Return decisions in input order and a final state consistent with the last decision.

criteria.description: Accept an ordinary live lifecycle and stop live-only updates after termination.
checks: NEW, MODIFY, and TERMINATE are accepted in sequence.
The TERMINATE decision changes ALIVE to TERMINATED.
A later MODIFY is rejected and reports unchanged TERMINATED state.

criteria.description: Re-open closed report histories without allowing creation by REVIVE.
checks: NEW -> TERMINATE -> REVIVE -> MODIFY is accepted throughout and REVIVE returns ALIVE.
REVIVE from CANCELLED also returns ALIVE.
REVIVE while ALIVE is rejected without changing state.

criteria.description: Require NEW to establish the trade while allowing recovery after a rejected leading item.
checks: A leading REVIVE is rejected with FIRST_REPORT_MUST_BE_NEW and NEVER_EXISTED state.
A later valid NEW in the same stream is accepted and establishes ALIVE state.
A repeated NEW is rejected rather than resetting history.

criteria.description: Preserve the semantic difference between a trade that ended and a report that should never have existed.
checks: ERROR from an established state produces CANCELLED and preserves that distinct state in output.
CORRECT after ERROR is rejected and remains CANCELLED; REVIVE then CORRECT is accepted.
The close control CORRECT after TERMINATE is accepted, remains TERMINATED, and does not silently revive.

criteria.description: Apply explicit action-specific preconditions rather than one broad update predicate.
checks: VALUATION and MARGIN_UPDATE are accepted only while ALIVE.
TERMINATE is accepted only while ALIVE.
POSITION_COMPONENT is accepted only while ALIVE and otherwise rejected without changing state; this is the benchmark's explicit focused policy.

criteria.description: Validate and compare the actual CDM 7.0.0 UTI representation.
checks: Require UNIQUE_TRANSACTION_IDENTIFIER and exactly one non-blank, trimmed assigned identifier value.
Accept a positive assigned-identifier version change when the UTI value is unchanged.
Reject a different UTI value with UTI_MISMATCH while preserving the first accepted NEW's complete typed UTI.

criteria.description: Fail individual reports closed without corrupting or terminating stream processing.
checks: Null reports, null actions, malformed UTI structures, and invalid versions yield MALFORMED_REPORT decisions.
Every rejected decision reports the unchanged state and does not replace the anchored UTI.
A valid later report is still evaluated and accepted when its state/action pair permits it.

criteria.description: Make batch results stable and handle stream-level boundaries explicitly.
checks: A null top-level list throws IllegalArgumentException; empty input returns null UTI, no decisions, and NEVER_EXISTED.
The decision list is a defensive unmodifiable copy and the input list and CDM values remain unchanged.
Accepted decisions use NONE, rejected decisions use the precise non-NONE reason, and output has exactly one decision per input.
